records.title: Mitigating Over-Personalization in LLMs via Structured Memory
records.reason: The abstract evaluates memory formatting to reduce over-personalization and preserve utility; it reports no inference cost, latency, or memory-efficiency improvement.

records.title: Parallelizing LLM Agent Execution with Contrastive Task Allocation
records.reason: The ACM DOI page and author-linked PDF both returned HTTP 403, so evaluation numbers, conditions, and limitations remain unverified.

records.title: From Habits to Discovery: Deploying LLMs for Personalized Generative Recommendations at Spotify
records.reason: This is an applied recommendation-system deployment report, and neither a specific inference optimization nor body-level efficiency evidence could be confirmed.

records.title: Caduceus: MoE Foundation Models for Unifying Biological and Natural Language
records.reason: The work trains MoE foundation models for biological and natural-language understanding; its claimed advances are training/task quality, not inference efficiency.

records.title: FedVAR: Prototype-aligned federated framework for Video Anomaly Recognition
records.reason: The abstract studies federated video-anomaly recognition alignment and communication during federated learning; it is not LLM inference/serving.
